sloka: अतिकायं त्रिशिरसं धूम्राक्षं च निशाचरम् ।अतिक्रम्य महावीर्यान्किं प्रशंसथ रावणिम् ।। ७.१.३७ ॥
transliteration: atikāyaṁ triśirasaṁ dhūmrākṣaṁ ca niśācaram ।atikramya mahāvīryānkiṁ praśaṁsatha rāvaṇim ।। 7.1.37 ॥

translations.english: The speaker asks about Indrajit's power, strength, and prowess, and by what reason he is considered superior to Ravana himself.
